purpose: Verify that the system opens a dedicated course workspace when an authorized user selects their course.
preconditions: A user is enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: The user selects Course C101 from their course list.
expected_result: The system opens the dedicated course workspace (course home page) for Course C101.

purpose: Verify that the course home page displays syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), and TA(s).
preconditions: Course C101 workspace is configured with syllabus, schedule, assigned instructors, and assigned TAs; authorized user is logged in.
action_or_input: The user opens the course home page for Course C101.
expected_result: The course home page displays the course syllabus, schedule, instructor(s), and TA(s).

purpose: Verify that access to a course workspace is restricted and denied to users not enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to the course.
preconditions: User U2 is not enrolled in, assigned to, or linked to Course C101; user U2 is logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: User U2 attempts to access the course workspace URL or page for Course C101.
expected_result: The system denies access to Course C101 workspace and displays an authorization error or restricts access.

purpose: Verify that an assigned Faculty member can configure the course workspace settings for their course.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 accesses workspace configuration for Course C101, updates workspace settings, and saves.
expected_result: The system accepts and applies the workspace configuration updates for Course C101.

source_id: AFR-LMS-002.2: Publish and edit course details (CFR-LMS-002)
purpose: Verify that Faculty can edit and publish course details for an assigned course.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101; course details exist in the workspace.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 edits the course description and syllabus text, then clicks publish.
expected_result: The system updates and publishes the edited course details, making them visible in the course workspace.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can add course materials as files, external links, and text notes.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101 and logged in.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 adds three material items to Course C101: a file upload (document.pdf), a web link (https://example.com/ref), and a text note ('Lecture Summary').
expected_result: The system successfully creates and saves all three material items with their respective types (file, link, note).

purpose: Verify that Faculty can organize course materials into modules or weekly sections.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101; course materials exist in the workspace.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates a section 'Week 1 - Introduction' and assigns material items to this section.
expected_result: The system organizes the materials under the specified module/weekly section.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can configure a future release date and time for course material.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101; material item M1 is being added or edited.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 sets the release date/time for M1 to a future date (T_future) and saves.
expected_result: The system stores the future release date/time and marks material M1 as scheduled for future release.

purpose: Verify that scheduled course material becomes published and available to authorized course users when the scheduled release time is reached.
preconditions: Material M1 in Course C101 is scheduled with release time T_release; system time reaches T_release.
action_or_input: System time advances to T_release, and an enrolled student accesses the materials section of Course C101.
expected_result: Material M1 transitions to published/available state and is visible to the authorized course student.

purpose: Verify that an enrolled Student can view published course materials in read-only form.
preconditions: Student S1 is registered in Course C101; published materials exist in Course C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 navigates to the Course C101 materials section.
expected_result: The system displays published course materials to Student S1 in read-only form without edit or upload controls.

purpose: Verify that an assigned TA can view published course materials in read-only form.
preconditions: Teaching Assistant TA1 is assigned to Course C101; published materials exist in Course C101.
action_or_input: TA1 navigates to the Course C101 materials section.
expected_result: The system displays published course materials to TA1 in read-only form without material authoring or modification controls.

purpose: Verify that a linked Observer can view published course materials in read-only form.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to Course C101; published materials exist in Course C101.
action_or_input: Observer O1 navigates to the Course C101 materials section.
expected_result: The system displays published course materials to Observer O1 in read-only form with no edit, upload, or modification capabilities.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can post a course-wide announcement for an assigned course.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 enters announcement title 'Exam Date Update' and body 'Midterm is on Friday', then submits.
expected_result: The system creates and publishes the announcement for Course C101.

purpose: Verify that a TA can post course announcements only when permitted, and is restricted when permission is not granted.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to Course C101 without announcement posting permission; TA2 is assigned to Course C101 with announcement posting permission.
action_or_input: TA1 attempts to post an announcement; TA2 submits an announcement in Course C101.
expected_result: The system blocks TA1 from posting the announcement due to lack of permission, and allows TA2 to successfully post the announcement.

purpose: Verify that the system records a timestamp for each posted course announcement.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101; system clock is synchronized.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 posts an announcement 'Welcome to Class' at timestamp T_post.
expected_result: The system saves and displays the announcement with an accurate creation timestamp equal to T_post.

purpose: Verify that a posted announcement is visible to all users enrolled in or linked to the course (Students, TAs, Observers).
preconditions: An announcement A1 is posted in Course C101; Student S1 is enrolled, TA1 is assigned, and Observer O1 is linked to Course C101.
action_or_input: Student S1, TA1, and Observer O1 each view the announcements section of Course C101.
expected_result: The system displays announcement A1 to Student S1, TA1, and Observer O1.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can create a new assignment for an assigned course.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 initiates and submits a new assignment creation form for Course C101.
expected_result: The system creates a new assignment record in Course C101.

purpose: Verify that the system captures and validates due date, instructions, submission type, and points possible when configuring an assignment.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is creating an assignment in assigned Course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 enters due date (2026-12-01 23:59), instructions ('Solve exercises 1-5'), submission type ('file'), and points possible (100), then saves.
expected_result: The system successfully captures and stores all four configuration fields (due date, instructions, submission type, points possible).

purpose: Verify that Faculty can edit an existing assignment in an assigned course.
preconditions: Assignment A1 exists in Course C101; Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 updates the instructions and due date of Assignment A1 and saves the changes.
expected_result: The system updates the assignment record with the edited instructions and due date.

purpose: Verify that a newly created or edited assignment remains in Draft state until explicitly published by Faculty.
preconditions: Faculty F1 creates or edits Assignment A1 in Course C101 without triggering publish.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 saves Assignment A1.
expected_result: The system sets Assignment A1 status to 'Draft', keeping it unpublished and unavailable to students.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can publish an assignment that is in Draft state.
preconditions: Assignment A1 in Course C101 is in Draft state; Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 selects Assignment A1 and clicks publish.
expected_result: The system transitions Assignment A1 status from Draft to Published.

purpose: Verify that a published assignment is withheld and not visible to students prior to its configured release date/time.
preconditions: Assignment A1 is published in Course C101 with a future release date T_release; Student S1 is enrolled in Course C101; current time is before T_release.
action_or_input: Student S1 accesses the assignments list for Course C101.
expected_result: The system withholds Assignment A1; Assignment A1 is not visible or accessible to Student S1.

purpose: Verify that a published assignment becomes available to authorized students when the configured release time is reached.
preconditions: Assignment A1 is published in Course C101 with release time T_release; Student S1 is enrolled in Course C101.
action_or_input: Current system time reaches T_release, and Student S1 views the assignments list for Course C101.
expected_result: Assignment A1 is released and visible to Student S1 in the assignments list.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view and download a released assignment for their registered course.
preconditions: Assignment A1 is released in Course C101; Student S1 is registered in Course C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 opens Assignment A1 and clicks download on the assignment file/materials.
expected_result: The system displays assignment details and instructions to Student S1 and initiates the file download.

purpose: Verify that a Student can submit assignment work according to the configured submission type (file, text, or link).
preconditions: Student S1 is registered in Course C101; Assignment A1 is released with submission type configured as file upload; submission window is open.
action_or_input: Student S1 submits work matching the configured type (uploads document.pdf for file submission).
expected_result: The system accepts the submission matching the configured type and confirms receipt.

purpose: Verify that the system accepts and records a student submission made prior to the assignment due date.
preconditions: Assignment A1 in Course C101 has due date T_due; Student S1 is registered; current time is before T_due.
action_or_input: Student S1 submits assignment work before T_due.
expected_result: The system accepts the submission, records it with an on-time timestamp, and updates submission status.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view their own submission history for an assignment, and only their own history.
preconditions: Student S1 is registered in Course C101 and has submitted work for Assignment A1.
action_or_input: Student S1 navigates to the submission history page for Assignment A1.
expected_result: The system displays Student S1's submission history, showing submitted files/content and timestamps; no other student's submissions are exposed.

purpose: Verify that the system displays the student's submission status as submitted, late, or missing where applicable.
preconditions: Student S1 is registered in Course C101; Assignment A1 is submitted on time, Assignment A2 is unsubmitted past due date.
action_or_input: Student S1 views their assignment list and submission status for Course C101.
expected_result: The system displays status 'submitted' for Assignment A1 and status 'missing' (or 'late' where applicable) for Assignment A2.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can grade an individual student submission by entering points and feedback.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101; Student S1 has submitted work for Assignment A1.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 opens Student S1's submission, enters points (90/100) and feedback ('Good analysis'), and saves.
expected_result: The system saves the entered points and feedback for Student S1's submission.

purpose: Verify that an assigned TA can grade an individual student submission by entering points and feedback.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to Course C101; Student S1 has submitted work for Assignment A1.
action_or_input: TA1 opens Student S1's submission, enters points (85/100) and feedback ('Well structured'), and saves.
expected_result: The system saves the entered points and feedback for Student S1's submission.

purpose: Verify that the system records the identity of the Faculty member or TA performing the grading action.
preconditions: TA1 is assigned to Course C101; Student S1 has submitted work for Assignment A1.
action_or_input: TA1 grades Student S1's submission and saves points and feedback.
expected_result: The system attributes the grading action to TA1 and records TA1's user identity in the grading record.

purpose: Verify that entered grade and feedback are kept in Draft state until released.
preconditions: Faculty F1 or TA1 grades Student S1's submission for Assignment A1 without triggering release.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 saves the grade and feedback for Student S1.
expected_result: The system stores the grade and feedback in 'Draft' state.

source_id: AFR-LMS-011.2: Hide draft grade from Student (CFR-LMS-011)
purpose: Verify that students are prevented from viewing draft grades and feedback prior to release.
preconditions: Student S1's submission for Assignment A1 has been graded, but the grade is in Draft state; Student S1 is logged in.
action_or_input: Student S1 views the assignment submission and grades page for Assignment A1.
expected_result: The system hides the draft grade and feedback; Student S1 cannot view the grade or comments before release.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can release draft grades and feedback to students.
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101; Assignment A1 has draft grades entered.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 initiates and confirms the release of grades for Assignment A1.
expected_result: The system transitions grades from Draft to Released state and makes them accessible to students.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view their own grade and feedback after release.
preconditions: Grades for Assignment A1 in Course C101 have been released; Student S1 is enrolled in Course C101.
action_or_input: Student S1 navigates to their grade report / assignment view for Assignment A1.
expected_result: The system displays Student S1's points awarded and feedback comments.

source_id: AFR-LMS-012.2: Released grade is read-only to Student (CFR-LMS-012)
purpose: Verify that released grade and feedback are presented to the Student in read-only form without edit permissions.
preconditions: Student S1 is viewing their released grade and feedback for Assignment A1.
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to edit, modify, or submit changes to the displayed grade or feedback.
expected_result: The system presents the grade and feedback in read-only form and prevents any modification by Student S1.

source_id: AFR-LMS-013.1: Log post-release grade change actor (CFR-LMS-013)
purpose: Verify that the system logs the identity of the actor who modifies a previously released grade.
preconditions: Student S1's grade for Assignment A1 is already in Released state; Faculty F1 is assigned to Course C101.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 modifies Student S1's released score from 85 to 90 and saves.
expected_result: The system logs the grade change and records Faculty F1's user identity in the audit trail.

source_id: AFR-LMS-013.2: Log post-release grade change time (CFR-LMS-013)
purpose: Verify that the system logs the timestamp when a released grade is changed.
preconditions: Student S1's grade for Assignment A1 is in Released state; Faculty F1 modifies the grade at timestamp T_change.
action_or_input: Faculty F1 submits a revised grade for Student S1 at timestamp T_change.
expected_result: The system records an audit log entry containing the exact timestamp T_change of the modification.

purpose: Verify that an assigned TA can view course details, published materials, and announcements.
preconditions: Teaching Assistant TA1 is assigned to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: TA1 accesses the Course C101 workspace, opens course details, published materials, and announcements.
expected_result: The system grants TA1 view access to course details, published materials, and announcements for Course C101.

purpose: Verify that an assigned TA can view Student submissions for their assigned course.
preconditions: Teaching Assistant TA1 is assigned to Course C101; students have submitted work for Assignment A1.
action_or_input: TA1 opens the submissions list for Assignment A1 in Course C101.
expected_result: The system displays student submissions to TA1 for grading and review.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a TA from creating or editing assignments.
preconditions: Teaching Assistant TA1 is assigned to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: TA1 attempts to create a new assignment or edit an existing assignment in Course C101.
expected_result: The system blocks the action and returns an authorization error, preventing TA1 from creating or editing assignments.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents a TA from creating or editing course materials.
preconditions: Teaching Assistant TA1 is assigned to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: TA1 attempts to upload new course materials or edit existing materials in Course C101.
expected_result: The system blocks the action and returns an authorization error, preventing TA1 from creating or editing course materials.

source_id: AFR-LMS-014.5: TA cannot modify course structure (CFR-LMS-014)
purpose: Verify that the system prevents a TA from modifying course structure.
preconditions: Teaching Assistant TA1 is assigned to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: TA1 attempts to add, reorder, or delete course modules or weekly sections in Course C101.
expected_result: The system denies the modification request and displays an authorization error, preserving course structure.

source_id: AFR-LMS-015.1: Observer reads permitted course content (CFR-LMS-015)
purpose: Verify that an Observer can view course details, published materials, and announcements for the linked course in read-only form.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: Observer O1 accesses Course C101 and views course details, published materials, and announcements.
expected_result: The system allows Observer O1 to view course details, published materials, and announcements in read-only form.

purpose: Verify that the system prevents an Observer from viewing individual Student submissions.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to Course C101; students have submitted work for Assignment A1.
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to access student submissions for Assignment A1.
expected_result: The system denies access and prevents Observer O1 from viewing any student submissions.

source_id: AFR-LMS-015.3: Observer cannot view grades/student-specific data (CFR-LMS-015)
purpose: Verify that the system prevents an Observer from viewing student grades or any other Student-specific data.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to Course C101; student grades and records exist for Course C101.
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to navigate to or query student grades, gradebooks, or individual student performance records.
expected_result: The system blocks access and prevents Observer O1 from viewing any student grades or student-specific data.

source_id: AFR-LMS-015.4: Observer has no write access (CFR-LMS-015)
purpose: Verify that the system prevents an Observer from performing write actions anywhere in the LMS Course Management module.
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to Course C101 and logged into the LMS.
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts write operations in Course C101 (such as posting an announcement, uploading material, submitting an assignment, or grading).
expected_result: The system rejects all write operations by Observer O1 with an authorization failure.
